BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Honeyford, Becker, Bailey, Brown, and Wilson

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preserving farm and agricultural land; and adding a new section to chapter 36.70A RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A school may not be sited within one-quarter mile of any property that is farm and agricultural land as defined in RCW 84.34.020.
